product_overview: A Streamlit-based personal and family finance manager that consolidates transactions, computes core financial metrics (50/30/20, autonomy, financial score) and provides projections and alerts to help users plan and control budgets.
core_goals: Centralize incomes, expenses and patrimony in a single view
Provide intelligent analysis (50/30/20 adherence, financial score, autonomy) and monthly projections
Support individual and consolidated family views (per person and 'Casal')
Detect recurring transactions and enable manual transaction management with categorization
Raise budget and projection alerts to prompt corrective actions

features.name: User Login
features.description: Authenticate users via Supabase email/password to unlock the authenticated dashboard and data.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Enter email -> Enter password -> Click Login -> See dashboard
Navigate to / -> Enter email -> Enter password -> Click Login -> See authentication error message from Supabase (invalid credentials) -> Remain on login view

features.name: Dashboard & Core Metrics
features.description: Display financial summary and visualizations including total income, total expense, balance, 50/30/20 breakdown, autonomy months and an aggregate financial score.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Select month/year -> See total income value -> See total expense value -> See balance value -> See 50/30/20 breakdown percentages -> See financial score and qualitative health label
Navigate to / -> Select month/year -> See 'No transactions found for this period' message -> See prompt to add transactions

features.name: Transactions Management (Lançamentos e Recorrentes)
features.description: Allow manual creation of income and expense transactions, automatic detection/generation of recurring (fixed) transactions, and categorization into Needs (Essenciais), Wants (Estilo de Vida) and Investments.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open sidebar -> Click 'Add Transaction' -> Fill date field -> Fill amount field -> Choose transaction type (Income/Expense) -> Choose category (Essential/Want/Investment) -> Click Save -> See transaction listed in the period and persisted to Supabase
Navigate to / -> Open sidebar -> Click 'Add Transaction' -> Fill amount field (leave date empty) -> Click Save -> See validation error 'Date required' -> Stay on transaction form

features.name: Patrimony Management (Saldos e Bens Duráveis)
features.description: Record account starting balances and durable assets to compute total patrimony used in autonomy calculations and long-term planning.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open sidebar -> Click 'Patrimony' -> Click 'Add Asset' -> Enter asset name -> Enter current value (positive number) -> Click Save -> See asset appear in patrimony list -> See updated total patrimony and updated autonomy months

Navigate to / -> Open sidebar -> Click 'Patrimony' -> Click 'Add Asset' -> Enter asset name -> Enter negative value -> Click Save -> See validation error 'Value must be positive' -> Remain on asset form

features.name: Alerts, Projections & Insights
features.description: Provide end-of-month balance projections, budget alerts when categories exceed thresholds (80% / 100%), and contextual insights such as largest impact item and month-over-month deltas.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Select month/year -> See projection of end-of-month balance based on current consumption -> If projection negative, See 'At risk' alert and mitigation suggestions
Navigate to / -> Select month/year -> See category spend percentages -> If a category exceeds 80% threshold, See budget alert for that category -> Click alert to view contributing transactions
Navigate to / -> Select month/year -> Projection engine attempts to fetch transactions from Supabase -> Supabase returns error -> See 'Projection currently unavailable' message

routes.description: Streamlit single-page application with sidebar navigation
